evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.04 Torr at the start of growth, in line with the ramp baseline of about 3.04-3.07 Torr.
Pressure rose steadily to 3.329 Torr (about +0.05 Torr per 120 s) and has not levelled off.
Ar flow held at about 100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by extra gas input.
Temperature is stable at 750 °C and heater power is steady at about 46%; the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked and air getting in cannot be ruled out.

args.missing_evidence: Two faults fit the rising pressure: a blocked exhaust (restricted pumping) or a seal leak letting air in. Telling them apart needs an O2 or residual-gas reading at the exhaust, a leak-up/rate-of-rise test, or a check of the pump and throttle-valve position and the exhaust line.
